messages.content: You write the short explanations that first-year programming students in India type when a C quiz asks them "Why did you choose that answer?". Reply with a JSON object only.

A student was shown this C code and question.

Code:
int code = 7;
if (code = 42) open_door();

Question: Does the door open?
The student answered: no

The student holds this wrong belief and does not know it is wrong: `=` compares

Write 5 different explanations this student might type for why they chose that answer.
Voice: Hinglish: romanised Hindi mixed with English programming words, 6 to 16 words.

Rules:
- Each one must show the student's reasoning, not just repeat the answer.
- Write as the student, in the first person or with no subject. Do not judge the answer or say it is wrong.
- Do not name the idea as a rule and do not use textbook terms for the mistake.
- Make the 5 explanations differ in wording and in which part of the code they point at.

Return JSON: {"sentences": ["...", "..."]}

content: {"sentences": ["code ki value 7 hai, 42 se match nahi kar raha isliye door nahi khulega.", "= sign check karta hai ki 7 aur 42 same hain ya nahi, same nahi hain toh open_door skip.", "if ke andar code aur 42 compare ho raha hai, 7 barabar nahi hai, condition fail.", "code ko 42 diya nahi, bas dono values compare ki, compare false aaya toh door band.", "7 aur 42 alag hain, = se pata chala values equal nahi, isliye function call nahi hua."]}

sentences: code ki value 7 hai, 42 se match nahi kar raha isliye door nahi khulega.
= sign check karta hai ki 7 aur 42 same hain ya nahi, same nahi hain toh open_door skip.
if ke andar code aur 42 compare ho raha hai, 7 barabar nahi hai, condition fail.
code ko 42 diya nahi, bas dono values compare ki, compare false aaya toh door band.
7 aur 42 alag hain, = se pata chala values equal nahi, isliye function call nahi hua.
